answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 42 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 11 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 42 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 500 bought sponsors, each risking real money. A meadow that can be verified, a ferrous that can be measured, and a mirror that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
